correctness.rationale: The sum-zero hyperplane in characteristic three contains the diagonal vector and translation x_i→x_i+t preserves s2 and s4 since s3=s1³=0; the coefficientwise Igusa quartic is therefore a cone over explicit F(a,b,c,d). Independently computed all four affine Jacobian Gröbner bases over GF3: finite quotient lengths (12,12,12,12), each with twelve simple rational points; their union consists of 15 rational syntheme nodes and local Hessians have rank3. Independent normalized projective evaluations give Q(F3)=25 and Q(F9)=145. Resolution replaces each rational node with P1 and gives Y(F3)=70, Y(F9)=280; a quartic with isolated nodes is normal/geometrically integral, its crepant resolution K3 has b2=22. Deligne Weil absolute values |α|=3 and F9 equality ∑α²=22·9 force each α=±3; F3 trace 60 forces 21 plus and one minus; Lefschetz and the cone count 1+q Q(Fq) yield every extension and both claimed zeta functions. The finite enumeration supports the node/point steps, whereas Weil equality proves the infinite all-extension assertion.
